caption.text:
Three things people still say about carousels, checked against 2026 data.

Myth: carousels are dead.
2026: carousels hold the highest engagement per follower on Instagram, seven quarters running.

Myth: more slides means more reach.
2026: 7-10 slides finish; 18 slides get abandoned at frame four.

Myth: LinkedIn is text-only.
2026: native PDF documents are the top-engaging LinkedIn format.

Save this for your next planning argument.

sources: Buffer State of Social Engagement, March 2026 (52M+ posts)

slides.headline: Half of what you know about carousels is backwards
slides.sub: Three claims, three datasets, one uncomfortable conclusion.
slides.alt_text: Cover: 'Half of what you know about carousels is backwards' with a warning icon.

slides.headline: "Carousels are dead. Video ate them."

left.label: THE CLAIM
left.text: Short-form video owns reach, so static frames are a waste of a slot.

slides.alt_text: Contrast slide: the claim that carousels are dead next to engagement per follower data.

slides.headline: Video owns discovery. Carousels own intent.

right.label: WHAT CAROUSELS WIN
right.text: Depth, saves, and dwell time per viewer.

slides.verdict: Run both. Stop pretending they compete.
slides.alt_text: Contrast slide splitting what video wins from what carousels win.

slides.headline: "Ten slides is free reach."

left.label: PADDED DECK
left.text: Fifteen slides, one idea, four of them filler.
items: Each skip is a negative signal
Readers exit at the first flat frame

right.label: EARNED DECK
items: Every frame pays off the last

slides.verdict: Slide count is a budget, not a strategy.
slides.alt_text: Contrast slide comparing padded versus earned carousels.

slides.headline: LinkedIn's strongest format is a PDF
slides.metric_label: Engagement by impressions for native document posts
slides.finding: LinkedIn document posts now sit ahead of multi-image, video and text, and the gap widened year over year. The mechanism is dwell time: eight structured pages hold a reader on the post far longer than a caption.
slides.alt_text: Proof slide showing 7.00% engagement by impressions for LinkedIn document posts.

slides.headline: What the data actually says
bullets: LinkedIn PDFs are the top format
slides.alt_text: Summary slide with five data-backed takeaways.

slides.headline: Keep this for the next planning meeting
slides.text: Save the deck now — the sources are on every slide, so it survives a fact check.
slides.alt_text: Final slide asking readers to save the deck.
